comment: User-editable tiers for the economy filter block (tools/filter_update.py). A BaseType enters the highest tier whose min_chaos its live chaos value meets. 'style' lines are copied verbatim into each generated Show rule — edit them freely. Syntax (poewiki 'Item filter' guide): SetFontSize 1-45; Set*Color R G B [A] with 0-255 components; PlayAlertSound <1-16> [0-300]; PlayEffect <Red|Green|Blue|Brown|White|Yellow|Cyan|Grey|Orange|Pink|Purple> [Temp]; MinimapIcon <0-2, 0=largest> <same colors> <Circle|Diamond|Hexagon|Square|Star|Triangle|Cross|Moon|Raindrop|Kite|Pentagon|UpsideDownHouse>.
